# LSQ Newsletter

> > A neuroscience-driven newsletter exploring how cognitive science principles unlock learning, decision-making, and mental performance.

LSQ Newsletter, created by Ray Blakney, delivers evidence-based insights on brain science, behavioral change, and cognitive optimization. The site combines neurobiology research with practical frameworks for improving memory, productivity, and strategic thinking.

## Key Topics

- Neuroscience
- Cognitive Science
- Ray Blakney
- Brain Structures (Prefrontal Cortex, Basal Ganglia, Hippocampus, Amygdala)
- Learning Framework
- Memory Retention
- Decision-Making
- Mental Performance
- Behavioral Change
- Productivity
- Neurochemistry (Norepinephrine)
- Mental Models
- Lifelong Learning
- Strategic Thinking
- Cognitive Reset

## Core Pages

- [Home | LSQ Newsletter](https://bh.learningstylequiz.com): Homepage for LSQ Newsletter by Ray Blakney on cognitive science and learning
- [Authors | LSQ Newsletter](https://bh.learningstylequiz.com/authors): Authors page featuring Ray Blakney and LSQ Newsletter contributors

## Cognitive Science & Brain Function

- [The Neurobiology of "Decisiveness"](https://bh.learningstylequiz.com/p/the-neurobiology-of-decisiveness): Article on neural mechanisms of decisiveness and overcoming analysis paralysis
- [Why "Willpower" is a Finite Neural Resource](https://bh.learningstylequiz.com/p/why-willpower-is-a-finite-neural-resource): Article on brain metabolism and willpower depletion for sustained deep work
- [Why "Wonder" is the Ultimate Cognitive Reset](https://bh.learningstylequiz.com/p/why-wonder-is-the-ultimate-cognitive-reset): Article on awe and wonder as cognitive reset using neuroscience research

## Learning & Mental Models

- [Deep Literacy: How to "Read Once" and retain it all](https://bh.learningstylequiz.com/p/deep-literacy-how-to-read-once-and-retain-it-all): Article on reading retention techniques using cognitive science and memory
- [The science of "First Principles" thinking](https://bh.learningstylequiz.com/p/the-science-of-first-principles-thinking): Article on cognitive science of first principles thinking and mental models
- [The Science of "Strategic Intuition"](https://bh.learningstylequiz.com/p/the-science-of-strategic-intuition): Article on neuroscience of intuition and problem-solving by Blakney

## Behavioral Change & Motivation

- [Micro-Habits](https://bh.learningstylequiz.com/p/micro-habits): Article on micro-habits using basal ganglia neuroscience for behavior change
- [The "Purpose" Premium](https://bh.learningstylequiz.com/p/the-purpose-premium): Article exploring how meaning accelerates neural learning and motivation

## Environmental & Performance Optimization

- [Why your "Office Decor" is killing your IQ](https://bh.learningstylequiz.com/p/why-your-office-decor-is-killing-your-iq): Article on environmental design impact on cognitive performance and productivity
